summary: Risk rating HIGH: Large exposure threshold stated without a measured value; Intra-group exposure treatment; Derivative exposure measurement.

transaction.description: Intra-group derivative trade exceeding large exposure threshold

findings.title: Large exposure threshold stated without a measured value
findings.rationale: The description says the threshold is exceeded, but limit breach cannot be confirmed without exposure as a percentage of Tier 1 capital.
required_actions: Calculate total exposure to the counterparty group as a percentage of Tier 1 capital.

findings.title: Intra-group exposure treatment
findings.rationale: Basel sets no separate intragroup treatment, so the national rule applies at each tier of the group.
required_actions: Confirm which national intra-group limit applies to the booking entity.
Test the exposure against the eligible capital base.

findings.title: Derivative exposure measurement
findings.rationale: Derivative exposure value for large exposures uses SA-CCR.
required_actions: Measure the derivative exposure value using SA-CCR.

clarifying_questions: What is the transaction amount and currency?
What is the total exposure to this counterparty group as a percentage of Tier 1 capital?
Which legal entity and lender type is booking this, for example a commercial bank or an NBFC?
cross_regulation_notes: Obligations arise under BASEL_III, RBI. Each applies independently; meeting one does not discharge another.
Basel sets the 25% limit, while the intra-group treatment is set nationally. Test both, and apply the stricter result.
